name: cyclotriphosphate to NADP
summary: A 7-step route from cyclotriphosphate(3−) to NADP(+), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: nicotinate-nucleotide diphosphorylase (carboxylating)
reactions.equation: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + CO2 + diphosphate = quinolinate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: aspartate--tRNA ligase
reactions.equation: tRNA(Asp) + L-aspartate + ATP = L-aspartyl-tRNA(Asp) + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: biotin--CoA ligase
reactions.equation: biotin + ATP + CoA = biotinyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: nicotinate riboside kinase
reactions.equation: beta-D-ribosylnicotinate + ATP = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + H(+)
